note: A workflow is a skill that plays other skills in order. Steps MUST name existing skills. Anything multi-step becomes a workflow; anything single-job stays a skill.

workflows.artifact: ## Shipped: <feature> — branch, tests, review, PR link
workflows.description: Ship a feature from branch to merged PR with tests and review. Use when building anything shippable.
workflows.name: ship-feature

workflows.description: Fix bugs with diagnosis, minimal fix, and regression proof. Use for any defect.
workflows.name: fix-hotfix

workflows.description: Take a launch post from idea to published with review. Use for launches and announcements.
workflows.name: launch-post

workflows.description: Onboard a new hire to productive in 30 days. Use for every new team member.
workflows.name: onboard-hire

workflows.description: Run incidents from alert to verified fix with follow-ups. Use for production incidents.
workflows.name: incident-response

workflows.description: Research any topic into a sourced dossier with recommendation. Use for decisions.
workflows.name: research-dossier

workflows.description: Plan a complete trip from idea to packed bag. Use for any vacation.
workflows.name: plan-trip

workflows.description: Publish a newsletter issue from idea to sent. Use for weekly publishing.
workflows.name: publish-newsletter

workflows.description: Run an event from idea to toast. Use for parties and celebrations.
workflows.name: run-event

workflows.description: Move house from boxes to settled with safety audit. Use when relocating.
workflows.name: home-move
